rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
C = Q/V; parallel plate C = ε0A/d (with dielectric: Kε0A/d).
Parallel: capacitances add; same V across all.

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Series: reciprocals add; same Q on all.  ·  Stored energy U = ½CV² = Q²/2C.
